title: The Day the River Spoke
subject: English
summary: “The Day the River Spoke” is a story that teaches us the importance of nature and the need to protect our environment. It highlights how rivers are essential for all living beings because they provide water and support life. The story encourages us to listen to nature and understand the problems caused by pollution and human activities. It reminds us that we should not waste water or pollute rivers. The chapter teaches us that we must respect nature, protect our rivers and keep our environment clean for future generations.
